about: Every key the dashboard's Task registry panel reads from the task API (web/src/lib/api.ts: TaskRegistry, TaskEntry, FieldDoc, TaskValidation, TaskSaved, TaskDeleted), with its JSON type.
tests/test_contract.py::test_task_registry_contract checks each section against a live mock gateway.

list: GET /ratchet/tasks. detail: GET /ratchet/tasks/{name} for an API task. validate: POST /ratchet/tasks/validate. saved: PUT /ratchet/tasks/{name} (200). refused: its 422. deleted: DELETE /ratchet/tasks/{name}. field: every field spec, at any depth.
A key ending in [] is a list: the test checks every item. A nested object is checked key by key.
Types: string, number (int or float, not bool), bool, null, object, list; a|b allows either.
Add keys when the payload grows. Never remove or retype one: the dashboard and other clients rely on them.
